_comment: Regex patches applied to the downloaded client bundle (build/script.js)
before it runs, to make the Cordova/Android client work in a desktop
WebView and to enable manual/desktop login.
PROVISIONAL: these patterns are keyed to the minified client build and
MUST be re-derived/verified against the live client version (currently
3.2.13). Patterns that no longer match are skipped with a warning. This
seed list captures the KNOWN transform intents; the exact regexes need
the real bundle to finalize. See README.md.
Each entry: { file, find (Rust regex), replace, note }. `find` is applied
with the regex crate; `replace` uses $1.. capture refs.

patches.note: Redirect Cordova file-system asset paths to the local/CDN assets.

patches.find: return t\.m = e, t\.c = i, t\.p = "", t\(0\)
patches.replace:
window.singletons = t;
return t.m = e, t.c = i, t.p = "", t(0)
patches.note: Expose the webpack module registry as window.singletons.

LOGIN PATCH (provisional): wrap the play button's web-auth tap handler to also offer a manual Ankama-code entry that calls window.dofus.CustomAuth(null, code). The exact minified pattern for the _playBtn 'tap' handler is version-specific and must be captured from the real 3.2.13 bundle. Reference intent (from community): before _launchWebAuth(), open a confirm popup with a code input and call window.dofus.CustomAuth(null, code). The wrapper also auto-intercepts dofustouch://authorized?code=... in Rust on_navigation, so this patch is a fallback.
